counts.holdout_scope: E: main only, 80/160ms only, each complete source cycle, no Cartesian products

methods.source: Saved CSV tables only; no waveform, F0, synthesis, fit, SVD, or test was executed.
methods.group_weights: Equal overlapping window descriptions. Means, medians and quantiles are descriptive, not population estimates. Neither repeated windows nor source-cycle folds are independent samples.
methods.scopes: All scheduled windows; fixed reference overlap with [2.08,2.13); complement. D applies only to guard-overlapping windows and retains unavailable states.
methods.fractions: Us/V0 and Ut/V0 within each wave; paired changes are RAW_FULL fraction minus PML fraction, not ratio of power differences.
methods.original: The same original waveform is evaluated against counterfactual +/-3 target templates; it is not an edited original or an independent replicate.
methods.holdout: Main configuration, 80/160ms only; leave one complete saved-source-clock cycle out. Extra prediction benefit of source = MSE(target)-MSE(joint); of target = MSE(source)-MSE(joint). Folds and windows overlap. Positive values mean smaller held-out prediction error.
